name: Fortifying Heavyblade
description: Sink low with the blade cocked back so the whole body stands ready to drive through a held line.

name: Guanhook Plating
description: Slam the flat back of the blade into a raised shield and shove it out of the line of attack.

name: Mightcrest
description: Chop down between two shoulder-to-shoulder opponents so the blade parts them and opens a gap.

name: Might Longsweep
description: Advance by short steps behind the lowered pole so the body never leaves its cover.

name: Silt Rollcut
description: Sweep the blade in a wide qi-driven arc to push apart a closed rank of fighters.

name: Chime Redtassel
description: Slip the pole under an opponent's arm and heave with the hips to toss them aside.

name: Harrowing Facet Guanpole
description: Drive the blade's point and edge into the seam between plates with qi gathered at the tip.

name: Hourloom
description: Chain a shove then a chop then a sweep in one advance so qi carries each blow into the next opening.

name: Counterspike Linctus
description: Stand with the qi field spread around the body and the blade resting inside it like a limb.

name: Gustcrest
description: Draw the crescent across the target in a smooth arc that follows the curve of the blade.

name: Thornloom
description: Slide the pole along the forearm to meet a blow so its force runs away along the shaft.

name: Might Crescentback
description: Pace along the edge of the qi field so the blade stays within the body's sense of its surroundings.

name: Lancing Slashdown
description: Spread the qi field out along the pole so the blade's cut reaches a hand past the steel.

name: Equipoise Guantang
description: Turn the blade in a broad circle through the field to bat aside any weapon crossing into it.

name: Toxin Bladewheel
description: Hook the blade into an opponent's weapon and pull it through the field so it loses its angle.

name: Dismantling Ironsweep
description: Spin the blade in a standing circle fed by the qi field so it cuts anything entering the spinning space.

name: Guanbarrage
description: Gather the field into the blade at the top of the arc and bring it down in one splitting cut.

name: Rejuvenating Polebelly
description: Stand with the back shielded and the blade held wide so any side may be answered at once.

name: Might Bladecollar
description: Swing the blade across the front rank at waist height to cut down the nearest fighters.

name: Lancing Tailspike
description: Drive the butt spike backward under the arm into an enemy creeping up from behind.

name: Remnant Guanpole
description: Flick the eyes along the circle of foes to find the widest gap in their ring.

name: Granite Longsweep
description: Shuffle sideways around a small circle so no opponent can get behind the blade.

name: Raging Guantang
description: Spin the blade wide with qi in the arms to shove a crowd of attackers back from the wielder.

name: Gustloom
description: Cut at the right then switch the grip and cut at the left before the first opponent falls.

name: Heavyblade Hauberk
description: Hold the long pole level before the body with qi in the shaft so a crowd cannot press through.

name: Hourcrest
description: Charge at the thinnest point of a ring while sweeping left and right to open an escape path.

name: Tuftassault
description: Whirl the blade through a full turn at chest height so qi reaps every opponent within its reach.

name: Implacable Redtassel
description: Hold the pole slanted before the chest so any of the compiled cuts may spring from it.

name: Raging Heavyswing
description: Slash down along a sloped line from the shoulder to the opposite hip with the full edge.

name: Furrowing Slashdown
description: Whip the heavy butt end up and over to smash the opponent's weapon arm.

name: Silt Tailspike
description: Take one long stride and settle into the stance so the cut that follows lands with full weight.

name: Ironhilt
description: Cut once from the high line and again from the low line in one unbroken turn of the wrists.

name: Crestcloak
description: Turn the shaft against a descending blow and let the qi in the grip fling it away.

name: Cleaving Blaze Crescentback
description: Swing the blade in the heaviest arc the shoulders can drive with qi packed into the edge.

name: Hour Bladecollar
description: Run the compiled cuts one into the next without a pause so qi never leaves the blade between them.

name: Crestremedy
description: Stand with the weight divided between both feet like two rivers meeting and the blade poised over them.

name: Granite Bladewheel
description: Cut once with the blade's belly and again with its back in one paired turn.

name: Guangreave
description: Bend the pole around an incoming thrust the way a river curves round a rock.

name: Guanhook Jaunt
description: Pace the rim of an imagined basin so the blade keeps the foe within its low centre.

name: Chime Counterspike
description: Fix the gaze on a single mark across the field as a hawk does before the blade moves.

name: Subduing Heavyswing
description: Shove the pole forward between two opponents so they are pushed to opposite sides.

name: Blazeguan
description: Slash across and back in two tides with qi rising on the first and falling on the second.

name: Thorncrest
description: Meet two incoming weapons at the point where blade and shaft cross and hold them there.

name: Slagcrest
description: Sweep low along the line of the bank so qi carries the cut through all who stand upon it.

name: Lot Bladecollar
description: Cut once from each side so the two arcs meet at the target's centre in one joined cleave.

name: Crestthrash
description: Build qi behind the raised blade like a rising flood and let it fall in a single crushing cut.

name: Daybreak Crescentback
description: Hold the blade high and the knees bent like a hawk crouched on a branch ready to drop.

name: Rumble Crescentback
description: Drop the whole body forward behind a steep downward cut of the crescent edge.

name: Torrent Guantang
description: Flick the blade tip out sideways like a wingtip to tap an attack away from the body.

name: Torrent Bladewheel
description: Circle the opponent in a wide slow orbit while the blade follows overhead.

name: Iron Ironsweep
description: Cut upward from the low line with qi rising along the edge to lift the opponent's guard.

name: Hoarfrost Heavyswing
description: Hook the blade's inner curve around the opponent's arm like a talon and clamp it against the shaft.

name: Enduring Heavyblade
description: Spread the pole and blade out like a pinion feather to cover the whole flank from a blow.

name: Tempered Slashdown
description: Rise on the toes then stoop in one swift fall with the blade carrying the whole weight of the body.

name: Silt Redtassel
description: Leap forward from the perch and land behind a falling cut so distance closes as the blade lands.

name: Intenttuft
description: Stand with one foot on each of two imagined tracks and the blade ready to run along either.

name: Sanguine Guanpole
description: Cut along the left track in a rising slash that ends with the blade over the shoulder.

name: Counterspike Thrash
description: Cut along the right track in a falling slash that ends with the blade low at the hip.

name: Granite Guanhook
description: Hold the pole across both tracks so a blow on either side meets the same shaft.

name: Glancing Polebelly
description: Hop from one track to the other between two cuts so the opponent loses the line.

name: Might Tailspike
description: Advance two paces on parallel tracks while the blade sweeps a covering line ahead.

name: Rumble Counterspike
description: Cut along one track and cross over to the other in one stroke with qi surging at the crossing.

name: Chime Bladecollar
description: Hook the blade into the opponent's weapon then hook again from the other side to pull it free.

name: Hoarfrost Polebelly
description: Pin an enemy shaft between pole and blade along both tracks and hold it there with qi.

name: Tuftcuirass
description: Answer each blow with a deflection on one track and a cut returning along the other.

name: Hour Slashdown
description: Cut along both tracks in rapid sequence so the two lines close on the opponent from either side.

name: Needling Guantang
description: End the two-track pattern with a sweeping turn that runs both lines through every foe within reach.

name: Heartening Counterspike
description: Settle low with the blade hanging near the ground like the floor of a basin filled with qi.

name: Granite Rollcut
description: Cut from the outside inward along the line of a bowl's rim to catch the opponent mid-step.

name: Hiltcloak
description: Hold the blade upright so its broad face stands like the slope of a basin against an attack.

name: Heavyblade Canter
description: Step down and in toward the foe as water runs down a valley wall.

name: Guanhook Assault
description: Draw the blade through a very wide arc that takes in the entire front of the opponent.

name: Toxin Heavyblade
description: Hook the blade over the opponent's weapon from above and pull it down into the basin.

name: Silt Heavyswing
description: Wheel the blade in widening loops so the cuts fill the whole space the fight occupies.

name: Might Guantang
description: Raise the blade as if lifting water from the basin and drop it as a single crushing arc.

name: Redtassel Remedy
description: Turn the chest into the wind with the blade cocked back so the gale itself lends weight to the cut.

name: Granite Crescentback
description: Fix a bearing on the target and cut straight along it without letting the blade drift.

name: Chimeloom
description: Whip the pole across in a sudden gust to bat an attack away.

name: Gustguan
description: Step along the plateau's edge in a light sidelong run that keeps the blade between wielder and foe.

name: Invigorating Polebelly
description: Feel the wind against the face and the blade to know where the opponent stands and moves.

name: Tempered Longsweep
description: Slash across the line of the opponent's advance as a crosswind strikes a walker.

name: Enduring Redtassel
description: Hold the pole steady along the sworn line and let nothing cross it while qi flows into the shaft.

name: Toxin Ironsweep
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and yank it aside with a gust of qi from the lungs and arms.

name: Guanassault
description: Spin into a reaping cut that sweeps the open ground the way a gale sweeps a field.

name: Sanguine Bladecollar
description: Cleave down along the wind's own bearing with qi gathered in the blade at the top of the stroke.

name: Vital Crescentback
description: Stand with the feet wide on open ground and the blade held across the body.

name: Blaze Longsweep
description: Swing the blade in a long flat sweep across the open ground at knee height.

name: Thorntuft
description: Hold the pole slantwise before the body so attacks slide off it on the open side.

name: Silt Slashdown
description: Keep the same heading while stepping backward so the foe stays on the sworn bearing.

name: Heavyswing Assault
description: Hold the blade still for a breath before the cut falls so qi gathers in the arms.

name: Chimetuft
description: Drive the shoulder into the opponent's chest and heave the pole across to topple them.

name: Counterspike Hauberk
description: Turn a blow aside and let it carry past the wielder like a cliff edge sheds a falling stone.

name: Scything Guanpole
description: Step to the rim of the ground and cleave from there with the full weight of the blade.

name: Splitting Polebelly
description: Turn in a wide circle reaping the open ground with a sweeping cut of the whole pole.

name: Crestelixir
description: Sight along the blade to fix a bearing on the opponent and settle the stance on it.

name: Rumbletuft
description: Cut along the line of the gale's push so the blade rides the wind and lands harder.

name: Immovable Heavyblade
description: Hold the pole fixed along the bearing so every blow meets it at the same angle.

name: Soaring Ironsweep
description: Step to the sheltered side of the opponent and keep the blade pointing to windward.

name: Loomassault
description: Thrust the tip into the wind toward the opponent's chest with the wind's push at the back.

name: Equipoise Bladecollar
description: Spin the pole between the hands so the blade circles like a vane in a following wind.

name: Guanpole Maelstrom
description: Turn on the heel with the wind at the back and slash across in a quick sweeping arc.

name: Gyvehilt
description: Lock the opponent's shaft against the pole along the held bearing and keep it still with qi.

name: Redtassel Hauberk
description: Plant the pole before the body so a rushing opponent breaks upon it as wind breaks upon a rock.

name: Severing Bladewheel
description: Throw the whole body into the cleave with qi and wind together behind the falling edge.

name: Doctrine Guanhook
description: Chain thrust cleave and sweep along one unbroken bearing so the opponent has no angle to answer from.

name: Vital Guanpole
description: Let the body sway lightly with the wind and hold the blade loose and ready.

name: Cleaving Tailspike
description: Draw a light fast slash across the opponent's forearm with only the edge's last inch.

name: Chime Crescentback
description: Catch an attack on the flat of the blade and let it slip aside like a leaf in the wind.

name: Glancing Rollcut
description: Drift sideways a full pace with the weight barely on the feet.

name: Chime Ironsweep
description: Pull the hooked blade back in a sudden gust to tug the opponent off balance.

name: Blaze Heavyblade
description: Cut upward with a lift of qi like an updraft that raises the opponent's weapon with it.

name: Harrowing Heavyswing
description: Drop the blade through a cleave so quick that the wind seems to part before the edge.

name: Granite Guantang
description: Whirl the whole pole around the body in widening turns so the blade cuts everything within its circle.
